title: Chapter 389 Under The Battle Of Guide Mansion
content:
Chapter 389 Under The Battle Of Guide Mansion

In the sky, endless yellow mist surged, covering the entire city of Guide for ten miles at once, even covering the battlefield of the tens of thousands of troops below, the yellow clouds were densely covered, and even the sunlight was blocked.

"Hahahaha, Qin Ming, now you know how powerful this king is, so stay with me today!"

The Demon King of Huangshan laughed wantonly, full of pride, being able to leave behind a master of the same level who has been famous for a long time, even for it is a rare honor.

It is of great benefit to the improvement of one's own prestige.

I'm afraid that after today's World War I, the whole Ming Dynasty will spread his reputation, and even the whole continent will hear about it. How can this not excite him?

The monster race cultivates power but does not cultivate the heart, only blindly pursues powerful power, and does not restrain its own desires. It can be said that monks are more human than human beings, and their entire soul is completely controlled by desires.

Such a form of cultivation, naturally, like ordinary people, pursues fame and fortune, even more than that.

For a monster, it is not enough to have great power, but also to have enough reputation. With a huge reputation, and the reputation spread far and wide, there will naturally be countless little monsters who come to seek refuge and can greatly improve themselves. The forces under his command.

In today's battle, it seems that Guide Mansion can't escape, and it is destined to fall into the control of Huangshan Demon King, and even Dongjiang Province will fall to most of it.

In this way, the Huangshan Demon King has expanded about half of his territory, and it is a place where some human beings live. It is extremely rich and has sufficient blood food. It is a good hunting place.

But although the territory is good, it must have enough strength to protect it.

Although the Huangshan Demon King with high-level combat strength above the sixth rank of the Ming Dynasty can't handle it, he can ask other demon kings to come to help. Under the same camp, he has a righteous reputation, and no one will refuse.

But the bottom-level combat power below is not enough. Such a large place cannot be defended by the demon soldiers who are still weakened on the battlefield below after repeated battles.

Based on the Huangshan Demon King's estimate, after he kills Qin Ming in front of him, he turns around to deal with the soldiers below. By that time, his demon soldiers probably won't even be able to make up 10,000 soldiers.

Such a vast territory, how could a mere 10,000 demon soldiers be able to defend it. If you sprinkle it down, you can't even see a person's shadow.

But in the thousands of miles of mountains and forests behind him, all the demon soldiers with some intelligence were brought over by him, and the rest were just some ordinary beasts, which could not be used for much.

This is not in a hurry to ruin him.

Therefore, the Huangshan Demon King urgently needs a prestige, so that it can be spread and attract other demons from all over the world to come and seek refuge. By then, the lost strength will be recovered soon.

You must know, not to mention the various frontiers of the Ming Dynasty, there are many demons and monsters in the deep mountains and old forests of the dynasty alone, and even the slightly sparsely populated places have demons and monsters haunting large cities, and there are even powerful ones with successful cultivation bases. Ghosts are at work.

Just the gathering of these monsters scattered throughout the dynasty, there are tens of thousands of them. Compared with the power of the Huangshan Demon King before, they are only stronger than weaker.

"Huangshan Demon King, since you are ruthless, don't blame me for being ruthless."

Qin Ming, who had lost half of his strength, turned his eyes hard. Knowing the situation around him, he already understood that without any reinforcements, he had no way out and could not escape.

But since this is the case, he can't live, and the demon king in front of him can't even think about it.

As a powerhouse of the sixth rank, Qin Ming couldn't be killed so easily. A martial saint's dying counterattack is enough to make anyone feel intimidated.

"Hey, I don't even look at what you look like now, and dare to speak wild words."

Sneering a few times, the Demon King of Huangshan Mountain looked at Qin Ming, whose aura was mostly weakened in front of him, and raised a little bit of guard in his heart.

Being able to become the lord of a place, rising from an ordinary weasel to become the current Huangshan Demon King, naturally experienced countless bloody fights. In particular, the monster clan, known for their prey to the weak, has encountered countless situations of life and death, so naturally they would not be ignorant of the temporary counterattack.

Then Qin Ming didn't talk nonsense. He raised his hands, his face flushed red, his whole body was huge, and even his slowly fading breath began to recover, and it reached its peak all of a sudden, and it was still going on. Climbing rapidly, it seems that there is no end to it.

Seeing Qin Ming's actions, the Huangshan Demon King on the opposite side couldn't help but change his face, and his mind suddenly raised. His keen animal sense told him that the enemy on the opposite side suddenly became very dangerous, enough to kill him.

"Hahaha, Demon King of Huangshan Mountain, don't you want my life? Then come with me, so you can have a companion on the road."

Finally, when the aura reached a certain point, Qin Ming finally stopped moving, turned his head and looked at the opposite Huangshan Demon King, with a ferocious smile on his face.

Afterwards, his figure moved, and his speed reached an unbelievable level, and he appeared in front of the Huangshan Demon King in a very short moment.

Before he could react, he hugged Huangshan Demon King in his arms.

"Come with me!"

As Qin Ming said, the power in his body increased rapidly, becoming more and more terrifying, and the surrounding space trembled and distorted along with his body.

"Damn it, you want to blow yourself up!"

Huangshan Demon King said in horror.

The self-destruction of a Tier 6 powerhouse is not just a joke. If you use all your strength, the surrounding area may be razed to the ground.

Even if Qin Ming's self-destruction as a warrior is not as powerful as other cultivators and mages, it is still possible to destroy everything within a five-mile radius.

Under the self-explosion range of a sixth-order powerhouse, and it is still in the center, the Huangshan Demon King is not sure of being able to survive.

"Understand now, it's too late!"

Qin Ming glanced at the Huangshan Demon King, the hatred in his eyes had gradually dissipated, and in a few breaths, this enemy would fall with him, and no matter how great the hatred was, it would disappear with death.

The power in Qin Ming's body became more and more violent, his body became redder and bloodshot, and all the pores of his body seeped blood, and the surrounding space became more and more unstable, as if it would be broken at any time.

Finally, at the moment when Qin Ming had accumulated to the extreme and was about to blew himself up, the space around him suddenly shattered, and a hand stretched out from it, cutting off his arm holding the Demon King of Huangshan at once. Lifted the Huangshan Demon King and pulled it towards the broken space.

"No!"

Qin Ming let out an extremely unwilling roar, and an extremely bright white light flashed all over his body with a bang. The surrounding space was distorted and broken, all the ground was plowed, and countless soldiers who were fighting below also fell.

But the Huangshan demon king he wanted to destroy the most retreated from that space with a face full of rejoicing.

The battlefield is not far away, about 20 miles away.

A black hole appeared in the space, and two figures were dragged out of it, both of which fell to the ground in a state of embarrassment.

"Lucky, madman!"

The Demon King of Huangshan rejoiced that he survived the catastrophe, and then cursed Qin Ming secretly.

"Okay, no amount of scolding is useless, let's find a place to heal our wounds now!"

Another figure said to the Huangshan Demon King.

Afterwards, the two of them moved and left the place.
